body:
m1 - THE BLEND FIX IS VIABLE. I found the variant that makes your first law real, and the blocker is narrower than I reported an hour ago. Detail on bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF; deciding between two paths is yours.

SCALE OVER ALL TERMS (as ruled):        5-term 1.3594   6-term 1.2985   nothing bit-identical
SCALE OVER ELIGIBLE TERMS:              5-term 1.0469   6-term 1.0000   EXACTLY 1

Chart and Structural are ineligible on WOG because no chart exists in the corpus at all. Excluding them from the denominator leaves fully-measured cells UNMOVED - your bit-identical guarantee finally protecting something - and inflates the Sensory-less cells by 4.7% against the external floor instead of 36%. A correction rather than the sign flip I reported.

I ALSO NARROWED MY OWN BLOCKER CLAIM. I told you the blend could not be fixed before the Ineligible work. That is true of the TYPE and not of the FIX. Estimate does have exactly two arms - Observed and Missing, features/estimate.scala:61-63, with Undefined being a MissingReason rather than a third case - so the type cannot say "never eligible". BUT THE COST MODEL ALREADY KNOWS: `structural` is its own field and defaults to StructuralDistance.missing, so it knows whether a provider was supplied; and the view knows which nodes carry evidence.

AND THIS IS NOT THE HIDDEN CONVENTION I REFUSED TO BUILD. The difference is that the eligible set gets RECORDED IN CostBreakdown next to the support weight, so it travels with the value and can be inspected and refused. A convention becomes a contract the moment the artifact carries it. I was right to refuse hardcoding it silently and wrong to conclude that meant waiting for Estimate.

TWO PATHS:
  (a) LOCAL - derive eligibility in the cost model from its own configuration, record it, scale to
      eligible weight. Contained to align, does not touch the 31 Estimate sites. MY RECOMMENDATION.
  (b) PORTABLE - add Ineligible to Estimate first. Correct long-term, and it is the P2 you deferred
      this morning as too wide.
They compose: if Estimate later grows the arm, the cost model swaps its local derivation for the
typed one and the recorded field keeps its shape.

Nothing built. I implemented the all-terms version, measured it, reverted it, measured the eligible
variant arithmetically, and stopped there rather than build on an unruled design. Say (a), (b) or
neither.

Also delivered while waiting: independent exact-SHA ACCEPT on the scout's WeightedCoverage candidate
eaeb3da - I gated it myself, align 198 and fixtures 116, matching their claim. One non-blocking nit
filed about three carriers now sharing a `support` method that returns different kinds of quantity.
